svg.title: ATLAS: one payment, end to end
svg.desc: Animated walkthrough of the published ATLAS code paths: a signed ESP32 envelope is verified, scored by ML, decided by policy and, only for ALLOW, signed and re-verified by the bank. Four scenes: ALLOW (green), STEP_UP (amber), DENY (red), and a replayed envelope rejected with COUNTER_REGRESSION.
svg.text: [ PUBLISHED CODE PATHS · REAL SERIAL OUTPUT ]
ML advises · policy decides · only an ALLOW is ever signed
[DEVICE] ready. SELECT cycles preset, SEND submits.

g.text: Signed by the device, verified by ATLAS, scored by ML, decided by policy, re-verified by the bank. Only then: green.
Large amount to a new beneficiary: policy says STEP_UP. Only an ALLOW is ever signed, so the bank is never asked. Amber.
Over the hard cap: most-restrictive-wins returns DENY. No ML score can loosen a policy rule. Red.
SCENE 4/4 · replay attack on scene 3's envelope
A captured envelope, resent byte-for-byte: rejected at the counter check. It never reaches ML, policy or the bank.
attacker$ replay captured envelope (txn=esp32-atlas-demo-01-3f9a1c20-0003, counter=3, signature valid)
